name: Radio
summary: Native mutually exclusive choice with checked, disabled, required, form-value, and validation behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Label wrapper that aligns the native radio input with visible label text.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.description: Native radio input that owns selection, form, focus, and validation semantics.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible accessible label for the choice.

anatomy.name: selectedIndicator
anatomy.description: Generated inner dot produced by the checked native input state.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover on an available unselected choice.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the native control. Variant-specific selectors are implementation coverage of this same state.

states.name: checked
states.description: Selected state controlled by the native checked property.

states.name: requiredInvalid
states.description: Native required group with no selected value; invalidity is semantic and is not styled without the Error variant.

behavior.name: nativeSelection
behavior.description: Native radio behavior provides activation and keyboard movement within a named group without component JavaScript.

behavior.name: mutualExclusion
attributes: same name within one choice group
behavior.description: Choosing one native radio clears the other radios with the same form owner and name.

behavior.name: nativeFormValue
behavior.description: Only the checked radio contributes its configured value to native form data; reset restores default checkedness.

behavior.name: nativeDisabled
behavior.description: Unavailable choices use native disabled focus, activation, and form behavior.

behavior.name: nativeRequired
behavior.description: A required named group participates in native choice-group constraint validation.

behavior.name: validationSemantics
attributes: aria-describedby references feedback owned by Field Wrapper when present
behavior.description: Radio owns validation presentation and native invalid state while Field Wrapper owns associated feedback content.

behavior.name: selectionOwnership
attributes: checked establishes default checkedness in static HTML
one controlled group value in framework adapters
behavior.description: Static Web delegates live selection to the native named group; controlled adapters own one group value rather than independent item booleans.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible accessible label for the choice.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native group name shared by mutually exclusive choices.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value submitted when this radio is checked.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected independently from checked state.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Establishes default checkedness in static HTML; framework adapters may bind the live checked property as part of one controlled group value.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Requires one choice in the named native group; the composing Fieldset shows the standardized decorative marker once on its group legend, never on every option label.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for helper or validation feedback owned by a surrounding Field Wrapper.

accessibility: Use native input elements with type="radio" and one shared name for each mutually exclusive group.
Wrap related choices in Fieldset and provide a visible Legend that names the question.
Keep each visible label associated by wrapping its native input or using matching for and id values.
Use aria-invalid only for Error and associate helper or validation feedback with aria-describedby.
Success and Warning require non-color feedback in the surrounding Field Wrapper when validation meaning must be communicated.
Keep the visible option label stable and let native Space and arrow-key behavior update the named group.
Framework adapters should control one group value or use native defaultChecked, never independent booleans that can produce multiple checked items.

web.notes: Implemented by native named-radio markup and class composition in components/css/primitives.css; browser selection and form behavior remain authoritative.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render native named radio groups with the same class contract.
